test_is_valid_type_basic: test _is_valid_type to check if an object matches a single type like int or str
test_is_valid_type_union: test _is_valid_type to validate an object against a Union of multiple types
test_is_valid_type_collection: test _is_valid_type to verify all elements in a list, set, tuple, or dict match expected types
test_is_valid_type_nested: test _is_valid_type to recursively validate nested typed collections like List[int] or Dict[str, int]
create_get_detailed_type: create a call to _get_detailed_type to infer the full nested type annotation of a Python object
